editorial.blurb: Mella Café is a beloved neighborhood spot where exceptional coffee, fresh pastries, and thoughtfully crafted sandwiches create the perfect reason to linger.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for the fresh-baked pastries and Portuguese-style bread rolls, which reviewers say sell out; the pistachio croissant and egg frittata are standouts worth planning your visit around.

topDishes.note: Perfectly flaky and flavorful, a standout pastry reviewers rave about
